source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: While this model leads a unit, as your Command phase ends, if you control an objective marker that has the unit within its range, that marker stays yours until the opposing player has a higher Level of Control over it than you as a phase ends.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.
